_comment: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. Single source of truth for the invented business. Every document, inquiry and label is derived from this file. Nothing here is real.

business.name: Kestrel Hollow Plumbing
business.address: 22 Millrace Lane, Alderbrook (invented street and town)
business.website: none (inquiries arrive by web form and email)
business.customers: Homes and small residential buildings of up to 4 units

staff.name: Rosalind Tavares
staff.handles: complaints, refunds and disputes, policy exceptions, landlord and property-manager accounts, supplier and partnership offers

services_offered.name: Emergency plumbing repair
services_offered.pricing: emergency call-out fee plus hourly labour and parts

services_offered.name: Sewer line repair
services_offered.pricing: quote only, after a camera inspection

services_offered.name: Plumbing leak repair
services_offered.pricing: quote only, hourly labour plus parts

services_offered.name: Water heater service and replacement
services_offered.pricing: flat price for flush and tank replacement; tankless is quote only

services_offered.name: General plumbing repair
services_offered.pricing: hourly labour plus parts, with a written estimate over $300

hours.emergency_line: Answered 24 hours a day, every day including holidays
hours.closed_dates_note: The office and scheduled visits are closed on these dates. The emergency line still answers and after-hours emergency pricing applies.

call_out_fee.note: Covers travel and diagnosis. Credited toward the work if the customer approves it during the same visit.

emergency_call_out_fee.applies: Emergency visits, and any visit outside scheduled-visit hours, on Sundays or on closed dates. Replaces the standard call-out fee.

labour.billing: 30-minute increments after the first hour, minimum 1 hour

parts.note: Priced on the written estimate. Parts carry sales tax; labour does not.

flat_price_jobs.job: Drain cleaning, one fixture (sink, tub, shower or toilet)
Camera inspection of a drain or sewer line
Leak detection (electronic, finds the source of a hidden leak)
flat_price_jobs.note: Credited toward the repair if the customer approves it during the same visit
Includes permit and removal of the old unit
Includes permit and removal of the old unit

flat_price_jobs.job: Faucet replacement, customer supplies the faucet
Toilet replacement, customer supplies the toilet
Garbage disposal installation, customer supplies the unit
Whole-home plumbing inspection with written summary
flat_price_jobs.note: About 2 hours. Summary sent within 2 business days.

quote_only: Sewer line repair (after a camera inspection)
Leak and pipe repair (hourly labour plus parts)
pricing.discounts: None offered. No senior, military, repeat-customer or price-match discounts.

emergencies.definition: A burst pipe, a leak that cannot be stopped, sewage backing up into the home, or flooding.
emergencies.response: Technician dispatched through the emergency line, usually within 2 hours (not guaranteed).
emergencies.urgent_not_emergency: No hot water, a toilet that will not stop running, and a slow leak that is contained are booked as the next available visit, same day if requested before 12:00 and there is room.
emergencies.standard_lead_time: Standard appointments are usually 2 to 4 business days out; staff confirm the exact day.

safety_instructions._note: The only advice staff may give in a reply. Anything beyond this goes to a person.
safety_instructions.water_wont_stop: Turn off the main water valve, usually where the water line enters the house or near the water meter.
safety_instructions.gas_smell: Leave the building at once. Do not use switches, lighters or phones inside. Call the gas utility's emergency number or 911 from outside.
safety_instructions.sewage_backup: Stop using sinks, tubs, showers and toilets until a plumber has looked at it.

reschedule_and_cancel.no_show_or_no_access: The call-out fee of $89 is charged
reschedule_and_cancel.emergency_cancelled_after_dispatch: The emergency call-out fee of $175 is charged

warranty.parts: Covered by the manufacturer's warranty, not by Kestrel Hollow Plumbing
warranty.drain_cleaning: If the same drain clogs again within 30 days, one return visit is free
warranty.voided_by: Work altered or repaired by someone else

policies.access: An adult aged 18 or over must be present during the visit. Pets should be kept away from the work area.
policies.estimates: No work over $300 starts without a written estimate the customer has approved.
policies.refunds_and_disputes: The call-out fee is not refundable but is credited to approved work. Complaints and disputes are reviewed by the owner. Staff cannot promise a refund, credit or discount in a reply.
policies.insurance: Kestrel Hollow Plumbing can provide an itemised invoice and photos for an insurance claim. It does not file claims or give opinions on coverage.
policies.water_damage: Technicians stop the leak and repair the plumbing. They do not dry out, clean up or repair water damage; a restoration company is needed for that.
policies.communication: No visit is confirmed until a staff member confirms it. A reply is never an automatic confirmation or a price guarantee.
not_offered: Gas line or gas appliance work

contact_rules.availability_note: Live availability is not in the documents. Staff check the schedule before answering availability questions.
